content.title:
Scored quiz
Module 2
content.intro: This quiz covers all the lessons in this module. You must achieve 80% to pass. Good luck!

questions.prompt: What is the main goal of SDG 7?

options.value: Ensure universal access to clean water and sanitation
Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: SDG 7 specifically aims to ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: SDG 7 specifically aims to ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are components of sustainable energy access? (Select all that apply)

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Sustainable energy access includes availability, affordability, adequacy, safety, reliability, and low-carbon compatibility.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Sustainable energy access includes availability, affordability, adequacy, safety, reliability, and low-carbon compatibility.

questions.prompt: Approximately how many people globally still lack access to electricity?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: According to the 2024 SDG 7 Tracking Report, around 685 million people lack electricity access.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: According to the 2024 SDG 7 Tracking Report, around 685 million people lack electricity access.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between energy access and inclusive energy services?

options.value: Inclusive energy services are more expensive
Energy access only applies to urban areas

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Energy access refers to having energy, while inclusive services consider equity, quality, and usability for all.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Energy access refers to having energy, while inclusive services consider equity, quality, and usability for all.

questions.prompt: Which human rights are most directly impacted by energy access? (Select all that apply)

options.value: Right to an adequate standard of living

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Energy access is critical to the right to education, health, and an adequate standard of living. The right to bear arms is not internationally recognized as a human right.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Energy access is critical to the right to education, health, and an adequate standard of living. The right to bear arms is not internationally recognized as a human right.

questions.prompt: What is considered a clean cooking solution?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Electric induction stoves are clean cooking solutions, unlike charcoal or kerosene which contribute to indoor air pollution.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Electric induction stoves are clean cooking solutions, unlike charcoal or kerosene which contribute to indoor air pollution.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT part of the Multi-Tier Framework (MTF) for measuring energy access?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: MTF includes quality, reliability, and affordability but not energy efficiency rating as a core indicator.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: MTF includes quality, reliability, and affordability but not energy efficiency rating as a core indicator.

questions.prompt: What proportion of global clean cooking access deficit is concentrated in Sub-Saharan Africa?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Sub-Saharan Africa accounts for over 80% of the global clean cooking access deficit.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Sub-Saharan Africa accounts for over 80% of the global clean cooking access deficit.

questions.prompt: 9. Productive uses of energy typically include which of the following? (Select all that apply)

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Productive uses of energy are those that generate income or improve economic output, like irrigation, cold storage, and industrial appliances.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Productive uses of energy are those that generate income or improve economic output, like irrigation, cold storage, and industrial appliances.

questions.prompt: 10. Which tool uses geospatial data to identify priority areas for energy access interventions?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Energy Access Explorer uses geospatial data to identify areas for energy intervention planning.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Energy Access Explorer uses geospatial data to identify areas for energy intervention planning.
